Looking at the code, `tmp1` and `tmp2` are independent variables - they are assigned different method calls (`getSourceFile()` vs `getDestDirectory()`) and are used in different positions in the method call. The value of `tmp1` at line 24 does not depend on the value of `tmp2` at line 22.
